mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 77 degrees with overcast skies near Verona Area High School, and an elevated air quality index of 55 warrants a little extra caution today.

The city has shared important updates: the Verona Police Department is investigating a sexual assault case involving a school staff member reported on Sunday, August 30, and residents should prepare for traffic shifts on Highway M starting next week for the Aldi development project.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today at the Capitol, followed by music at Baileys Run and Paddy Macs, with trivia nights and the Verona Downtown Farmers Market taking place early next week.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday, August 30, they began an investigation that led to the arrest of a Madison resident for sexual assault of a child by a school staff member, with the case currently remaining open.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. The store is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
